features: Strain-rate to turbulence-frequency ratio marking strong shear layers and separation onset where SST eddy viscosity mis-predicts anisotropy.
Lagrangian acceleration vs turbulence timescale marking bump-crest acceleration, curvature and recirculation turning where SST mis-aligns stress.
Signed APG vs FPG sensor normalized by turbulence energy rate marking adverse-pressure-gradient separation and reattachment where SST mis-predicts anisotropy.
Strain-rotation imbalance marking streamline curvature and vortical recirculation cores versus pure-shear boundary layers on bump crest and CD diffuser.
Pressure-gradient magnitude versus wall-scaled turbulent acceleration distinguishing near-wall APG boundary layer from free-shear separation bubble.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 checked dimensionless (L-T invariance); avoid Umag or nut in denominators to prevent wall/stagnation blow-up; eps,k,Snorm+Wnorm floors make non-finite <1%; ordering distinct from I1,I2 (APG sign, Pk/eps non-equilibrium, W/S curvature) so low collinearity risk.

features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Non-equilibrium production-to-dissipation ratio marking separation shear layers where SST mis-predicts anisotropy.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed wall-scaled adverse pressure gradient work vs k marking APG deceleration and separation onset.

features.name: f_rot
features.rationale: Rotation-to-total deformation fraction marking curved shear, recirculation and reattachment with excess rotation.

proposal.risk_audit: All three are dimensionless (Snorm~omega~U/L; DUDt~omega*sqrt(k)~U^2/L; sqrt(k)~omega*d~U) and bounded 0-1 via r/(1+r) form so finite everywhere including wall (omega*sqrt(k)->inf, omega*d->inf gives 0 not NaN) unlike unbounded ratios; orderings distinct from f_noneq (Pk/eps), f_apg (signed APG work) and f_rot (W/(S+W)); drop f_apg,f_rot with terms_using=0 and heldout_gain=0 to free slots, retain f_noneq (gain>0); risk is mild correlation between shear/acceleration sensors but they separate shear magnitude vs turning vs wall distance needed for bump/CDC separation-reattachment.

features.name: f_strain
features.rationale: Strain-rate to turbulence-frequency ratio marking strong shear layers and separation onset where SST eddy viscosity mis-predicts anisotropy.

features.name: f_accel
features.rationale: Lagrangian acceleration vs turbulence timescale marking bump-crest acceleration, curvature and recirculation turning where SST mis-aligns stress.

features.name: f_wdist
features.rationale: Bounded SST-blending wall sensor distinguishing near-wall APG boundary layer from free-shear separation bubble and outer flow.

proposal.risk_audit: All three checked dimensionless under velocity x2 length x3 scaling; bounded in [-1,1]/[0,1] so finite except exact 0/0 at wall (<1% points, cell-centers have d>0,k>0,omega>0); f_apg signed ordering complements f_accel, f_curv orthogonal to f_strain, f_pgrad replaces dropped f_wdist wall role with pressure normalization to improve bump_h26 and CD-channel generalization without duplicating active features.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed APG vs FPG sensor normalized by turbulence energy rate marking adverse-pressure-gradient separation and reattachment where SST mis-predicts anisotropy.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Strain-rotation imbalance marking streamline curvature and vortical recirculation cores versus pure-shear boundary layers on bump crest and CD diffuser.

features.name: f_pgrad
features.rationale: Pressure-gradient magnitude versus wall-scaled turbulent acceleration distinguishing near-wall APG boundary layer from free-shear separation bubble.

features: DUDt_mag / (DUDt_mag + Umag * Snorm + gradp_mag + omega * sqrt(k))

proposal.risk_audit: All three verified dimensionless (L-T): Pk/(Pk+eps)= (L2/T3)/(L2/T3); omega*d/(omega*d+sqrt(k))= (L/T)/(L/T); DUDt/(DUDt+Umag*Snorm+gradp+omega*sqrt(k))= (L/T2)/(L/T2). All bounded in [0,1] or [-1,1], no log/exp, no bare division by Umag/d/k; only exact-wall 0/0 (d=0,k=0,Umag=0) can be NaN but training uses cell-centers with d>0,k>0,omega>0 so <1% affected. Orderings orthogonal to f_strain=Snorm/(Snorm+omega): noneq adds Pk-eps imbalance, wall adds d-scaling for near-wall vs free-shear, turn adds Lagrangian turning vs shear+pressure, avoiding collinearity with f_strain/f_apg/f_curv.

features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Non-equilibrium production vs dissipation imbalance marking separation shear layers and reattachment where Pk far exceeds eps and SST anisotropy lags.

features.name: f_wall
features.rationale: Wall-proximity vs free-shear sensor distinguishing near-wall APG boundary layer from detached free shear where SST stress error changes character.

features.name: f_turn
features.formula: DUDt_mag / (DUDt_mag + Umag * Snorm + gradp_mag + omega * sqrt(k))
features.rationale: Curvature/turning vs shear-pressure sensor marking bump-crest acceleration and recirculation streamline bending where eddy-viscosity mis-aligns stress.

features: DUDt_mag / (DUDt_mag + Umag * Snorm + gradp_mag + omega * sqrt(k))

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 features are dimensionless (UgradP, UgradK, eps share L2/T3; gradp_mag and omega*sqrt(k) share L/T2), bounded in [-1,1] or [0,1] so finite where eps>0, k>0, omega>0; distinct orderings from f_turn/I1/I2: signed APG work, pressure-force magnitude, and k-advection vs existing strain/wall/turn sensors; target worst heldout bump_h38/bump_h26 APG separation, crest FPG acceleration and reattachment transport; no Umag or d in denominators so no wall-zero blowup; keep f_strain/f_noneq/f_wall (gain 0.0 neutral, not negative) to allow combination next round since free_slots=6.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed APG vs dissipation marking adverse (UgradP>0) deceleration/separation and favorable acceleration on bump crest where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_pforce
features.rationale: Pressure-gradient magnitude vs turbulent acceleration scale marking pressure-dominated APG/FPG zones versus shear-dominated zones on bumps.

features.name: f_advk
features.rationale: Streamwise advection of k vs dissipation marking non-local TKE transport through separation bubble and reattachment where local Pk-eps balance fails.
